tiles.name: Wall
tiles.desc: Blocks movement and sight.

tiles.name: Pillar
tiles.desc: Blocks movement and sight.

tiles.name: Rubble
tiles.desc: Blocks movement. Half cover (+2 defense) against shots from the other side.

tiles.name: Crates
tiles.desc: Blocks movement. Half cover against shots from the other side.

tiles.name: Pew
tiles.desc: Blocks movement. Half cover.

tiles.name: Shallow water
tiles.desc: Costs 2 movement.

tiles.name: Floodwater
tiles.desc: Costs 3 movement. Ending a turn here slows you.

tiles.name: Mud
tiles.desc: Costs 2 movement.

tiles.name: Pit
tiles.desc: A hole in the board. Anything shoved in is gone.

tiles.name: Nothing
tiles.desc: The board has been erased here. Anything shoved in is gone.

tiles.name: Fire
tiles.desc: Burns whoever enters or ends a turn here.

tiles.name: Spikes
tiles.desc: Cuts whoever steps on it.

tiles.name: Bile
tiles.desc: Poisons whoever enters or ends a turn here.

tiles.name: Live rail
tiles.desc: Shocks whoever enters or ends a turn here.

tiles.name: Steam vent
tiles.desc: Scalds whoever ends a turn here.

tiles.name: Ice
tiles.desc: Stepping on it ends your movement and slows you.

tiles.name: Living floor
tiles.desc: Costs 2. Ending a turn here opens a wound.

tiles.name: Blood
tiles.desc: Slick, but only cosmetic.

tiles.name: Snare
tiles.desc: A hero's trap. Enemies who step in are cut and held.

tiles.name: Hidden snare
tiles.desc: Somebody set this for you.

tiles.name: Holy ground
tiles.desc: Blessed tiles: heroes standing here regain 2 HP at the start of their turn.

tiles.name: Conjured stone
tiles.desc: Blocks movement and sight.

tiles.name: Exit
tiles.desc: Step a hero here to leave the board.

tiles.name: Altar
tiles.desc: Half cover.

tiles.name: Gearbed
tiles.desc: Teeth in the floor.

tiles.name: Unpainted board
tiles.desc: Nobody finished this part. Ending a turn here leaves you dazed.

tiles.name: Giant die
tiles.desc: An oversized die. Blocks movement and sight.

statuses.name: Bleeding
statuses.desc: Takes 2 damage per stack at the start of its turn. Stacks up to 5.

statuses.name: Burning
statuses.desc: Takes 1d6 fire at the start of its turn.

statuses.name: Poisoned
statuses.desc: Takes 1d4 poison at the start of its turn and deals 1 less damage. Extra doses add duration.

statuses.name: Stunned
statuses.desc: Loses its next turn. -2 defense.

statuses.name: Asleep
statuses.desc: Loses its turns until it takes damage. Attacks against it have advantage.

statuses.name: Rooted
statuses.desc: Cannot move.

statuses.name: Slowed
statuses.desc: Movement halved.

statuses.name: Dazed
statuses.desc: Disadvantage on its d20 rolls.

statuses.name: Vulnerable
statuses.desc: Takes 50% more damage.

statuses.name: Weakened
statuses.desc: Deals 40% less damage.

statuses.name: Marked
statuses.desc: Attacks against it get +2.

statuses.name: Hunted
statuses.desc: Attacks against it get +1 and deal 3 extra damage.

statuses.name: Doomed
statuses.desc: Attacks against it have advantage and deal 4 extra damage.

statuses.name: Hexed
statuses.desc: Takes 2 extra damage from every source. -2 to saves.

statuses.name: Cursed
statuses.desc: -3 to saves and healing received is halved.

statuses.name: Rotting
statuses.desc: Cannot be healed.

statuses.name: Frightened
statuses.desc: Disadvantage on attacks. Cannot move next to whatever frightened it.

statuses.name: Confused
statuses.desc: On a d20 of 8 or less, its abilities hit a random unit in range instead.

statuses.name: Taunted
statuses.desc: Must target whoever taunted it, if it can.

statuses.name: Silenced
statuses.desc: Cannot use spells.

statuses.name: Exposed
statuses.desc: Attacks against it have advantage.

statuses.name: Jinxed
statuses.desc: Its d20 can show nothing higher than 12.

statuses.name: Card seized
statuses.desc: One of its ability cards has been taken.

statuses.name: Guarded
statuses.desc: +3 defense.

statuses.name: Riposte
statuses.desc: When a melee attack misses it, it strikes back for 1d6 + Might (once per turn).

statuses.name: Protected
statuses.desc: While its protector stands adjacent, hits against it land on the protector instead.

statuses.name: Warded
statuses.desc: Takes half damage from everything.

statuses.name: Regenerating
statuses.desc: Regains 3 HP at the start of its turn.

statuses.name: Empowered
statuses.desc: +3 damage per stack.

statuses.name: Blessed
statuses.desc: +2 to attacks and saves.

statuses.name: Inspired
statuses.desc: +4 to its next d20 roll, then gone.

statuses.name: Sanctified
statuses.desc: Immune to new debuffs.

statuses.name: Hidden
statuses.desc: Cannot be targeted from more than 1 tile away. Its next attack has advantage. Taking damage or attacking reveals it.

statuses.name: Raging
statuses.desc: Halves physical damage taken, +2 damage dealt, cannot cast spells.

statuses.name: Steadfast
statuses.desc: Cannot be pushed or pulled.

statuses.name: Slippery
statuses.desc: Moving away does not provoke attacks.

statuses.name: Deadeye
statuses.desc: Next attack crits on 15+ and ignores cover.

statuses.name: Hasted
statuses.desc: +2 speed and +1 defense.

statuses.name: Growing
statuses.desc: +1 damage per stack. Gains a stack each turn nobody hurts it.

statuses.name: Brittle
statuses.desc: -3 defense.
